I loved Risk Management. My favorite FBA course by far. I knew I had a thing for finance, but only after taking risk management did I realize that that's where my passion lies. Even though the things you learn in this course are introductory to quite an extent, they are very practical and extremely interesting to learn about. We talked about futures, forwards, swaps, options, risk hedging using these derivatives, designing arbitrage strategies, pricing these investment and risk management tools, and even studied actual cases of investment firms using these tools and strategies. BUT, fair warning. This is a technical course and a challenging one at that. This has been the only course I have taken in Bilkent so far where I actually went to the teacher's office hours to understand things better, that too after the second lecture in the first week! I mean some classes will leave you grabbing your head by the end and you will leave the class wondering what just happened. It's also a moderate-to-fast-paced course so we cover quite technical stuff very quickly. But if you keep at it, put in some extra effort, try and understand what's happening, attend all classes, and follow what Ahmet Hoca is saying, you'll be okay. Also, take this course from Ahmet Hoca only because he makes things a lot easier and explains them in an excellent way. He sometimes even spoonfeeds us challenging topics so that we understand things properly. All in all, best course ever.
